title: Bias of the basis-expanded generator
statement: Let $\ell>0$ and let $t,n$ be nonnegative integers with $t\le\ell$ and $n=2^{\ell-t}$. The basis-expanded small-bias generator density on $\mathbb{F}_2^{n\ell}$ has every nonzero vector Fourier coefficient bounded in absolute value by $2^{-t}$.
